tool.name: bcftools @EXECUTABLE@

xml.name: use_tag
xml.token_help: Which FORMAT tag to read from the input file. By default, uses PL if present, otherwise falls back to GT.

tool.command:
@PREPARE_INPUT_FILE@ #set $section = $sec_restrict @PREPARE_TARGETS_FILE@ @PREPARE_REGIONS_FILE@ #set $section = $sec_default #set $genotypes_vcf = None #if $section.comparison_mode.mode == 'reference': #if $section.comparison_mode.genotypes: #if $section.comparison_mode.genotypes.is_of_type('vcf') #set $genotypes_vcf = 'genotypes.vcf.gz' bgzip -c '$section.comparison_mode.genotypes' > $genotypes_vcf && bcftools index $genotypes_vcf && #elif $section.comparison_mode.genotypes.is_of_type('bcf') #set $genotypes_vcf = 'genotypes.bcf' ln -s '$section.comparison_mode.genotypes' $genotypes_vcf && #if $section.comparison_mode.genotypes.metadata.bcf_index: ln -s $section.comparison_mode.genotypes.metadata.bcf_index ${genotypes_vcf}.csi && #else bcftools index $genotypes_vcf && #end if #end if #end if #end if
bcftools @EXECUTABLE@
## Default section #set $section = $sec_default
#if $genotypes_vcf: --genotypes $genotypes_vcf ${section.comparison_mode.homs_only} #end if
#if $section.comparison_mode.use_tag: --use '${str($section.comparison_mode.use_tag).replace("_", ",")}' #end if
#set $section = $sec_restrict @REGIONS@ @TARGETS@
## Primary Input/Outputs
@INPUT_FILE@ > '$output_file'

param.name: mode
param.label: Comparison mode
param.help: Checks sample identity or when omitted a multi-sample cross-check is performed

param.name: genotypes
param.label: Genotypes to compare against
param.help: (-g) Checks sample identity against this reference dataset

param.label: Homs Only
param.help: Homozygous genotypes only, useful with low coverage data (requires reference genotypes -g)

expand.label: FORMAT tags to use (query, reference)
expand.help: Which FORMAT tags to read from the input (query) file and the reference (-g) file. By default, prefers PL for query and GT for reference with automatic fallback.
